senses.gloss: f.(b. h.; יָחַל)hope, expectation; that which may be looked for, good, use.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Pesachim 6:1:2">Y. Pes. VI, beg. 33ᵃ</cite> <he>אפשר שיש ממנו ת׳</he> possibly something good can come from him (may be he can enlighten us).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Pesachim 6:1:2">Ib.</cite> <he>כבר אמרנו שיש ממך ת׳</he> we have said that a good thing may be expected of thee.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Pesachim 6:1:2">Ib.</cite> <he>כבר אמרנו אם יש ת׳ מבבלי</he> we have said, can we expect anything of a Babylonian? <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 2:15">Num. R. s. 2<sup>15</sup></cite> <he>אין הימנו ת׳ וכ׳</he> nothing of consequence can come of him, he cannot beget &c.

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 2:15">Ib.</cite> <he>וכי יש בו ת׳</he> is there any good in it (can the golden calf produce any effect)? <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 37:2">Midr. Till. to Ps. XXXVII, 2</cite> <he>חציר הם תּוֹחַלְתָּם</he> what good there is in them is mere grass (cmp.

<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 909:3">Yalk. Job 909</cite>; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 27:3">Gen. R. s. 27</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 6:5">Gen. VI, 5</cite>) <he>משהיתה … לא היתה בהם ת׳</he> from sunrise to sunset they achieved nothing good; Yalk. ib. 47. Ib. 35, v. <cite ref="V00253"><he>תּוֹעֶלֶת</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 20:8">Num. R. s. 20<sup>8</sup></cite> <he>אם יבוא … אין בו ת׳</he> if he (Balaam) will be ready to go with us, he will succeed, but if he should delay even one hour, he will be of no use; a. e.

<cite ref="Berakhot 32b:9">Ber. 32ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Berakhot 55a:1">55ᵃ</cite> <he>כל המאריך … שנ׳ ת׳ וכ׳</he> he who makes long prayer and speculates on it (v. <cite ref="P00291"><he>עוּן</he></cite> h.) comes to sickness of heart, for it is said (<cite ref="Proverbs 13:12">Prov. XIII, 12</cite>) a prolonged prayer makes the heart sick; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 950:5">Yalk. Prov. 950</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 854:1">Yalk. Deut. 854</cite>.
